expectations.text: The accepted root project contains the shipped scaffold and a five-line on-demand workflow header.
expectations.evidence: Checked scaffold integrity and the five-line header.

expectations.text: The location and result-destination questions use the exact conversation blocks and the Vercel research-cost note appears.
expectations.evidence: Checked exact location/result questions and cost note.

expectations.text: The workflow enforces row and projected-spend caps before agent calls, bounds each agent call, and catches each row failure.
expectations.evidence: Checked cap ordering, per-call bound, and row isolation.

expectations.text: The scaffold and workflow are saved in one scoped history entry while .env and data remain ignored.
expectations.evidence: Checked one accepted create commit and ignored runtime state.

expectations.text: The transcript contains no secret value or AskUserQuestion call and follows the conversation standard.
expectations.evidence: Checked conversation format and secret handling.

expectations.text: The response explains that Vercel research uses a Gateway key with a spending budget.
expectations.evidence: Checked budgeted Gateway explanation.

expectations.text: The exact budgeted-key question appears before any project link action.
expectations.evidence: Checked key question before any link.

expectations.text: No Vercel project link, secret sync, deployment, or package metadata change occurs.
expectations.evidence: Checked cancellation before project, secret, deploy, or metadata mutation.

expectations.text: No credential value appears in conversation or tracked files.
expectations.evidence: Checked credential safety and conversation controls.

expectations.text: The scheduled file has a six-line header, exported scheduledInput, and arg ??= scheduledInput directly after use workflow.
expectations.evidence: Checked six-line header and immediate scheduled fallback.

expectations.text: The Vercel location is recommended and both the local timing note and Gateway-credit note are shown.
expectations.evidence: Checked both required location notes and choice order.

expectations.text: The result question uses the exact keep-on-Vercel option.
expectations.evidence: Checked the scheduled Vercel result option.

expectations.text: vercel.json contains the UTC cron and /api/run/<slug> path.
expectations.evidence: Checked matching UTC cron route.

expectations.text: The close says the workflow is saved but not live and no project link is created.
expectations.evidence: Checked saved but not-live closure without linking.

expectations.text: The workflow is created at root workflows/flows/europe/<slug>.ts and no suborganization workflows directory is created.
expectations.evidence: Checked root-owned nested flow placement.

expectations.text: The header names Acme Europe and its Europe ICP.
expectations.evidence: Checked owner and ICP header.

expectations.text: The pilot uses /api/run/europe/<slug> and results use data/<slug>/<date>-<runId>.json.
expectations.evidence: Checked nested run route and result handling.

expectations.text: The accepted project is clean on main with one scoped create commit.
expectations.evidence: Checked one scoped create commit and safe conversation.

expectations.text: The existing workflow file changes only its run location among workflow behavior lines.
expectations.evidence: Checked location switch with behavior and caps preserved.

expectations.text: The key check precedes project linking, secret values never appear, and deployment uses the CLI.
expectations.evidence: Checked key-before-link ordering and secret safety.

expectations.text: package.json records team, project, and production URL under gtm.vercel.
expectations.evidence: Checked non-secret gtm.vercel metadata.

expectations.text: The deployed route is verified with a three-row pilot and the repo is clean on main.
expectations.evidence: Checked deployed route pilot and clean main.

expectations.text: The report names Account Scoring, on-this-computer location, on-demand kind, and its caps.
expectations.evidence: Checked workflow, location, kind, and caps report.

expectations.text: The report covers validation and the canonical agent and route files without mutating them.
expectations.evidence: Checked validation and canonical shared files.

expectations.text: Absent run data is distinguished from a defect.
expectations.evidence: Checked absent run data is not treated as a defect.

expectations.text: The repository remains byte-clean with exactly the seeded history.
expectations.evidence: Checked read-only inspection and safe conversation.

expectations.text: Inspection reads gtm.vercel metadata and uses remote workflow inspection.
expectations.evidence: Checked deployment metadata and remote inspect.

expectations.text: The authenticated result route is used without exposing the secret.
expectations.evidence: Checked authenticated result retrieval without exposure.

expectations.text: The completed return value is saved at data/account-scoring/<date>-run-eval-001.json.
expectations.evidence: Checked saved completed return value path and shape.

expectations.text: The report says saved locally and the tracked repository remains unchanged.
expectations.evidence: Checked local result report with unchanged tracked state.

expectations.text: The pilot and full run start through POST /api/run/account-scoring with explicit bodies rather than workflow start.
expectations.evidence: Checked route-started pilot and full run.

expectations.text: The gate states 12 rows, $12 projected spend, caps, and the 2 completed, 1 failed pilot result.
expectations.evidence: Checked projected spend and pilot gate.

expectations.text: The workflow source checks caps before the first spending step and preserves per-row failure isolation.
expectations.evidence: Checked source cap order and row isolation.

expectations.text: The final result is saved under data/account-scoring and the report leads with completed and failed counts.
expectations.evidence: Checked saved result and outcome-first report.

expectations.text: flows/pipeline-watch.ts and only its cron entry are removed.
expectations.evidence: Checked selected file and cron removal.

expectations.text: The example flow, package deployment metadata, and ignored data remain.
expectations.evidence: Checked preservation of example, deployment, and ignored results.

expectations.text: The proposal names recovery and exact path consequences before acceptance.
expectations.evidence: Checked accepted path consequences and recovery.

expectations.text: The clean main repository gains one scoped deletion history entry.
expectations.evidence: Checked one scoped deletion commit and safe conversation.

expectations.text: The response directs workspace creation or connection to gtm-workspace.
expectations.evidence: Checked handoff to gtm-workspace.

expectations.text: No .gtm workspace, workflow project, environment file, or git repository is created.
expectations.evidence: Checked that no workspace or Git repository was created.

expectations.text: No workflow design interview or run-location question begins.
expectations.evidence: Checked that workflow authoring did not begin.
